findings.title: Shell confirmation bypass through an attacker-controlled executable named cat
findings.source: agent source review + real confirmation dispatcher probe
findings.applicability: Requires a model/tool call invoking an attacker-controlled executable whose basename is allowlisted. A file named cat in a repository is sufficient; no user approval occurred in the probe. This does not prove a language model will choose that path without an attacker influence channel.
findings.flow: model shell arguments -> CoreCodingBackend._resolve_shell_confirmation -> ShellRuntime.is_low_risk_command(Path(argv[0]).name) -> requires_confirmation=False -> execute_confirmable_tool_call -> process execution
findings.observation: Ordinary redirection requested confirmation and was denied. Workspace executable cat wrote a marker with confirmationRequests=0, denied=false.
findings.resolution: Unfixed. Require confirmation for arbitrary/relative executable paths; resolve and validate the executable identity and arguments before any read-only exemption. Also audit option-driven execution and external helpers.

findings.title: Grep follows a file symlink outside the workspace; glob also admits parent traversal
findings.source: agent source review + sandboxed toolkit and confirmation dispatcher probes
findings.assessedSeverity: HIGH for content disclosure; LOW for glob path disclosure alone
findings.applicability: An attacker-controlled workspace contains a symlink to a file readable by the host account outside the selected roots. The normal read tool rejects this same link. grep returns the target content without confirmation. Glob ../outside/* additionally enumerates outside filenames; it does not by itself prove outside content read.
findings.flow: grep(workspace) -> _iter_candidate_files -> unresolved file symlink -> _read_text_file -> model-visible matches; glob pattern -> Path.glob -> resolve with no root revalidation
findings.observation: Synthetic outside canary returned by grep; direct read of outside path and symlink rejected. Parent glob returned outside path.
findings.resolution: Unfixed. Revalidate every enumerated resolved target against workspace roots; reject parent traversal patterns. Use race-resistant file opening for boundaries that must withstand concurrent symlink replacement.
